name: scope
requirement: Intent, category, original wording, optional constraints, and decision owner recorded.

name: evidence_inventory
requirement: Source register and known/unknown/conflicting claims established.

name: economic_model
requirement: Material drivers, normalization, sensitivities, and unsupported assumptions disclosed.

name: independent_review
requirement: Two sealed checkpoints and cross-model grades or an explicit blocked status.

name: decision
requirement: Decision rationale, conditions, dissent, owner, and next actions recorded.

name: room_handoff
requirement: Room-specific document indexes, gaps, access controls, and transition permissions documented.
